notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]NextFest starts tomorrow!
[/b]
We've been working hard to improve our demo with multiple updates, making it more polished and enjoyable. With today's final update, we've now completed the demo in its current form. However, keep in mind that this demo only represents a small portion of our game!

There are still many details we plan to add, and we have already started working on Early Access to bring those ideas to life.

With this final update, we have:
[list]
[*] 
[*] Fixed an issue where time continued to progress during combat dialogue.
[*] Resolved a bug causing the market outline to darken after the market tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue where vehicles would get stuck at city entrances.
[*] Corrected a UI overlap in the pause menu where the ‘Back’ button overlapped with the ‘Add to Wishlist’ button.
[*] Fixed a problem where colors would shift and vehicle headlights wouldn’t turn on after leaving a city.
[*] We hope NextFest goes well for our game and gives us even more motivation for the Early Access phase. Huge thanks to everyone who has supported us so far!
[/list]

Two Nomads

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #7
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Wastelanders,[/h1]

We have just released a hotfix addressing several issues reported by the community. Thank you for your feedback and continued support during Demo. Below are the details of the fixes included in this update:

[[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where vehicles would get stuck in cities.
[*] Fixed the bug where clicking on a city would trigger combat.
[*] Optimized vehicle movements.
[*] Added a panel where you can view your vehicles in-game.
[*] Added location display on the map.
[/list]

Your feedback is invaluable in shaping Iron Convoy. If you encounter any additional issues, please report them through our bug report system. Thank you for being part of this journey!

Stay safe on the road,
Iron Convoy Development Team

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #6
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Wastelanders,[/h1]

We have just released a hotfix addressing several issues reported by the community. Thank you for your feedback and continued support during Demo. Below are the details of the fixes included in this update:

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where the demo would start in Turkish even on English-language devices.
[*]     Resolved an issue where players were sent to buy fuel without sufficient money, yet still completed the quest.
[*]     Investigated and potentially resolved the issue preventing players from crafting car parts using in-game materials. Further testing is ongoing.
[/list]

[h2]Audio Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Fixed incorrect quest completion audio in Rustport, which was playing the Arena quest acceptance sound instead.
[/list]

[h2]Save System[/h2]

[list]
[*]     The game did not have an auto-save system, leading to lost progress when returning to the main menu. While a full auto-save system is under consideration, we have implemented a temporary manual warning panel once you want to return to main menu.
[/list]

Your feedback is invaluable in shaping Iron Convoy. If you encounter any additional issues, please report them through our bug report system. Thank you for being part of this journey!

Stay safe on the road,
Iron Convoy Development Team

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #5
notes.notes:
[h1]Iron Convoy - Hotfix Update[/h1]

Hello Survivors,  

We're back with a new hotfix update! This update fixes some critical issues while also improving the overall performance of the game.  

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed issues with the vehicle parts crafting panel.  
[*] Fixed resource gathering issues on the map.  
[*] Fixed a visual bug when attaching wheels to vehicles.  
[/list]  

[h2]Performance and Optimization[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Optimized convoy creation processes.  
[*] Improved convoy movement for a smoother experience.  
[/list]  

[h2]New Feature - The First Steps of Trading[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added preliminary trade mechanics in preparation for the upcoming trading system.  
[*] In the future, you'll be able to trade with your convoy and acquire valuable resources!  
[/list]  

Thank you for your support! Feel free to share your feedback and thoughts with us.  

Stay strong and survive the wasteland!  

[i]— Iron Convoy Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Iron Convoy - Hotfix Update[/h1]

[h2]Hello raiders,[/h2]

This update brings important improvements and bug fixes to enhance the game's fluidity and overall experience. Here’s what has changed:

[h3]Updates and Improvements[/h3]

    Part Installation Animation: Installing parts is now smoother with an added animation.
    Zoom In/Out: The part installation screen now supports zooming in and out for better visibility.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

    Audio Desync Issue: Fixed sound effect desync problems.
    Utility Parts Hover Bug: Resolved an issue where utility parts were not properly selectable when hovered over.

Your feedback is invaluable to us. Keep strengthening the convoy!

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

While we continue to fix the issues we've identified in the game, we're also focusing on adding new content. After yesterday's update, here are the latest additions and improvements:

[list]
[*] Continued the demo story.
[*] Mechanic UI rework.
[*] Added new characters and their voiceovers.
[*] Made visual enhancements and adjustments.
[*] Updated materials.
[*] Fixed lighting issues.
[*] Implemented the quest system.

[*] Introduced a mysterious car key.

[*] Fixed combat-related bugs.
[*] Added new UI elements.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458157/45ef239441439d78f6cd6d6d3643dce5466822e9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458157/fc8fb0a92dc268f5acaff5f769bcf99216317c1f.png[/img]

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has played and tested our game so far! 🙌 We’d like to remind you that we’re still in the demo phase, and we truly believe that, with your feedback, we’ve made the demo even better.

Here’s what we’ve improved:
[list]
[*] Demo story introduction added.
[*] Narrator characters implemented.
[*] Map entry sequence reworked.
[*] Confusion in the Main Menu resolved.
[*] Character creation screen adjusted.
[*] Mechanic building and UI completely redesigned.
[*] Collectible items on the map are now more visible.
[*] Control mechanics updated (Mouse1 - Movement, Mouse2 - Camera Movement).
[*] Main Menu music added.
[*] Interactions with other convoys improved.
[*] Combat UI updated.
[/list]

We’re currently working on the continuation of the demo story, and another update will be coming soon! With that update, the full demo story will be available for you to experience.

Thank you for all your feedback! 🚛🔥
